Definition: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
BiblicalUsage: prep; 1) from, out of, on account of, off, on the side of, since, above, than, so that not, more than; 1a) from (expressing separation), off, on the side of; 1b) out of; 1b1) (with verbs of proceeding, removing, expelling); 1b2) (of material from which something is made); 1b3) (of source or origin); 1c) out of, some of, from (partitively); 1d) from, since, after (of time); 1e) than, more than (in comparison); 1f) from...even to, both...and, either...or; 1g) than, more than, too much for (in comparisons); 1h) from, on account of, through, because (with infinitive); conj; 2) that
